set.rappels: Rappel the East Face on its own line, about a dozen or more rappels on doubled ropes over roughly 2,400 ft, every anchor built from slung horns, chockstones and gear: there are no bolts anywhere on the route. No station list is published.
set.rappel_count_note: The only documented descent is the first ascent’s, which rappelled the face top to bottom on natural anchors, roughly a dozen-plus rappels; no station list or count has been published since, so none is shown. On that descent the first rappel hung up and had to be freed by climbing back to the top, and the anchors were angled toward the northeast ridge to find sounder rock than the ascent line.
